package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestRequireInternalTokenUsesExactIndistinguishableRejection(t *testing.T) {
	calls := 0
	handler := RequireInternalToken("exact-secret")(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		calls++
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
	}))
	var rejectedBody string
	for _, token := range []string{"", "wrong", " exact-secret", "exact-secret "} {
		request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal", nil)
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q status=%d", token, response.Code)
		}
		if rejectedBody == "" {
			rejectedBody = response.Body.String()
		} else if response.Body.String() != rejectedBody {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q produced distinguishable rejection %q versus %q", token, response.Body.String(), rejectedBody)
		}
	}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "exact-secret")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusNoContent || calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("exact token status=%d calls=%d", response.Code, calls)
	}
}
